original_test_intent: Verify every physical control on the tray button-panel board produces its specifically approved tray response.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies each button, applies its approved press or hold duration one at a time, captures the visible and platform response, restores normal state and records the result per button.
manual_activity: An authorized operator must locate, press or hold and directly observe every physical tray button; the agent can only package read-only corroborating evidence.
required_inputs: Exact chassis/tray/button-panel board revision and verified target identity
Complete button labels, locations, functions and expected response matrix
Per-button press/hold/debounce timing and observation window
Normal-state restoration, abort and independent recovery procedures
Camera/timestamp plan plus BMC/OS/log corroboration map
safety_requirements: Authorize every button before actuation, especially power, reset or service controls
Operate one button at a time with workloads drained when required
Stop on unexpected power, reset, LED, thermal, BMC or console behavior
Do not infer function from a label or emulate a press with software
Preserve logs and physical evidence; do not clear faults
Do not repeat an ambiguous or unsafe action automatically
agent_execution_scope: Verify the approved matrix and target identity before the operator acts
Collect read-only baseline and post-action BMC/OS/log evidence
Correlate operator timestamps with platform transitions
Package per-button evidence without issuing button-equivalent mutations
Make no physical observation claim, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the complete button/response/timing and safety matrix
Provide a qualified operator and direct physical evidence
Resolve any ambiguous label, response or recovery and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No executable command is supplied because the defining stimulus and observation are physical; this is correct.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use no command as a substitute for the physical press. Read-only status and logs may corroborate but never replace operator evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All tray buttons, expected tray responses, Manual Validation and 30/30-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL ONLY OWNER-APPROVED PER-BUTTON PHYSICAL MATRIX
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a signed one-button-at-a-time matrix containing physical identity, press timing, expected visible/platform response, corroborating evidence, recovery and per-button disposition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the unspecified button set and acceptance criteria auditable without inventing hardware behavior.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Software status alone cannot prove the intended physical control was actuated or that the button mechanism, labeling and response path work.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some buttons may reset or power the tray, so a generic press-all instruction could disrupt workloads or destroy evidence. Exact effects and recovery must be approved first.

project_override_considerations: Board-revision-specific missing or reserved buttons may be excluded only by an owner-approved exact panel map; their absence must remain visible rather than silently reducing the denominator.
expected_evidence: Timestamped per-button pre-state, physical press/hold and direct visible response
Read-only BMC/OS/log correlation for state-changing controls

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and both prior reviews consistently require physical tray-button actuation. Missing button identities and response timing are readiness gaps, not contradictory source meanings.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The agent cannot execute the defining physical action, but a qualified authorized operator can; therefore the case is MANUAL ONLY rather than globally BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Retains MANUAL ONLY while converting the vague phrase all buttons work into a complete owner-approved physical matrix with explicit safety and evidence boundaries.
independent_technical_reasoning: A software command that triggers the same logical function bypasses the button cap, switch, debounce circuit, panel wiring and physical label-to-function mapping, so it cannot validate this testcase. Each button needs its own denominator and response evidence; otherwise one working control could be incorrectly generalized to the entire panel. State-changing controls must be isolated because an unexpected reset can erase volatile evidence and affect workloads.
